Package org.jdesktop.lg3d.mandela.values

Class MandelaInstance

java.lang.Object
org.jdesktop.lg3d.mandela.values.MandelaInstance
public final class MandelaInstance extends Object
An instance of a declared type.

Fields live in one MandelaMap keyed by name. That is slower than a slot array and is the right trade for a scripting desktop: a script can add a field to an object it did not declare, str() prints every field whatever the class, the JSON encoder can serialise any instance without the class cooperating, and the field set is exactly what an editor needs to offer as completion.

Equality depends on the declaration kind. A type is a value: two Point(1, 2) instances are equal, which is what makes value semantics worth having. A class is an identity: two Window objects with the same bounds are still two windows. An enum constant is created once, so identity equality already gives the singleton behaviour.
